caption: The drawing features a wooden chest or sideboard positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The chest has a rectangular structure with a flat, overhanging top, two large drawers at the bottom, and three vertical compartments above. The wood is depicted in shades of light brown, with darker brown and black details. There are decorative, vertical columns with black accents separating the compartments, and the central compartment features an ornate square and cross motif. The two compartments on either side of the central section have door panels, each adorned with pointed arch shapes and a keyhole. The lower drawers are simply outlined, each with a central knob, while the chest rests on short, rectangular feet. The background is unadorned, drawing attention solely to the chest’s structure and detailing.
title: Chest with Two Drawers
